title: Impact of Compulsory Schooling on Wages
research_question: Does additional compulsory schooling affect individuals' wages later in life? The study investigates the causal impact of education, as mandated by compulsory schooling laws, on the log of wages earned by individuals.
data_description: The dataset contains 500 observations with columns: y (log wages), x (years of education), z (compulsory schooling year), and controls (age, gender, region). The compulsory schooling year serves as an instrumental variable for education.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use compulsory schooling year as an instrument for education.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The analysis suggests that additional compulsory schooling has a negative impact on log wages.
